reviews.title: Not cheap but good quality and nice rgb.
reviews.comment: Awesome fans.  Never have to run them over idle and they look awesome.  Rock solid.  Nzxt software is good and never any connection issues like my lian-li fans.

reviews.title: Great fans!
reviews.comment: They work great and fit perfectly into the H6 Flow case. I wish they were ARGB but it does come with a hub for RGB. Easy to set up.

reviews.title: Premium product
reviews.comment: Great RGB lighting, easy to install and helped finish out my build. Premium look and feel.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: no problems here
reviews.comment: I recently installed the NZXT F140 RGB Duo Twin Pack, and I'm thoroughly impressed! The dual fans not only look fantastic with their vibrant RGB lighting but also provide excellent airflow for my build. Installation was a breeze, and the included software makes it easy to customize the lighting effects. They run quietly, even at higher speeds, which is a huge plus. Overall, these fans are a great addition for both aesthetics and performance
reviews.author: Daylan

reviews.title: Looks Great, Works Great, and Very Quiet!
reviews.comment: These fans are beautiful, efficient, and quiet! My son loves them in his new build. The only downside, not enough to remove a star (in my opinion), is that I wished it was compatible with Aura Sync or any 3-pin argb motherboard. However, having to use NZXT Cam alongside Aura Sync has allowed my son to get pretty creative with the color combos. The Tron theme he tried is his current favorite!
reviews.author: Jessica Dixon
